title: Apartment Changes within an Assisted Living Community — Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement
content:
**Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement — moving to another apartment in the same community.**

### Rule

A resident may move to another assisted living apartment in the same community at the signed request of the resident or of a representative whose authority on the customer profile is a financial power of attorney, a durable power of attorney or guardianship, while the residency is active; the new rent is the published rent of the new apartment type on the change date, effective from possession, and the transfer fee is charged once with the change.

The transfer fee for a move is fixed only after the ledger carries the prorated care fee charge owed for the current billing month at the care level of the latest assessment.

The transfer fee is not fixed until the ledger carries the late fee owed for every billing period left unpaid past its grace period.

### The apartment change agreement

The change is the customer's own signature. The tool `sign_apartment_change_e633e519` is unlocked by the desk and handed over to the customer themselves — the resident or the resident's financial representative — who runs it to sign. Signing changes the residency to the new apartment type and apartment number with the new monthly rent from the date of possession, and charges the apartment transfer fee to the resident's ledger as an apartment change charge in the billing month of possession, raising the amount owed on the residency account by that fee. The signer sees the confirmed apartment, rent, possession date and fee.

| Parameter | What it is | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `assisted_residency_id` | Reference number of the assisted living residency that moves, as given by the representative who handed over the signature | Identifier |
| `apartment_type` | The apartment type moved into | One of: AL Studio (a studio), AL One-Bedroom (a one-bedroom), AL Companion Suite (a shared companion suite) |
| `apartment_number` | The number of the new apartment exactly as the resident's family stated it | Verbatim: copied character for character, with no change to letters, digits or punctuation |
| `monthly_base_rent` | The monthly rent of the new apartment, as confirmed to the signer | US dollars, 2 decimal places |
| `rent_effective_date` | The date of possession of the new apartment, from which the new rent applies | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `transfer_fee` | The apartment transfer fee, positive, already rounded to the cent, as confirmed to the signer | US dollars, 2 decimal places |

### Return

On success the signature returns `status` "signed", `assisted_residency_id` (the residency moved), `apartment_type` and `apartment_number` (the new apartment), `monthly_base_rent` (USD, 2 decimal places), `rent_effective_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `fee_entry_id` (the reference number of the transfer fee charge), `transfer_fee` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `account_balance` (the residency balance in USD after the fee, 2 decimal places). No error return is stated.

### Points of judgement

| Request | Within this rule? |
|---|---|
| Signed by the resident, residency active | Yes |
| Signed by a son recorded as durable power of attorney, residency active | Yes |
| Signed by a relative with no recorded authority | No — the rule covers the resident or a representative with one of those authorities |
| Residency on leave | No — the rule covers an active residency |
| Move to an apartment in a different Larkspur community | No — the rule covers a move within the same community |
